note: Fictional companies and people. Every T-number carries a valid 法人番号 check digit and is absent from the nationwide NTA data (5,787,472 corporations); Bayside's uses registry office 9999, which doesn't exist, so no real company can hold it. No corporation nationwide has any of these company names, even as a substring. Meigi Shoji's payout and the BEC wallet are the team's Sepolia demo wallets (DEMO_VENDOR_PAYOUT, DEMO_SCAMMER); the lookalike and Bayside's payout were generated for the demo and their keys discarded. Domains use the reserved .example TLD.
